description: hydrodynamic coupling FNPF -> NHFLOW (FNPF nesting into NHFLOW): fnpf_hdc_source_uvw writes state files with velocities (P 44 1) on 0-40 m, DIVEMesh H 10 4 converts them for the 10-30 m NHFLOW grid, this run reads eta and u, w as wave input (B 92 61) in the relaxation zone. Gauges at 20 m and 25 m follow the FNPF gauges.
covers: DIVEMesh HDC 4 for an NHFLOW grid
